query: DELETE FROM qq_messages m USING qq_identities i WHERE i.id=m.identity_id AND ((m.direction='in' AND m.group_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT m.mentioned AND m.created_at < $1) OR (i.user_id IS NULL AND m.created_at < $2) OR m.created_at < $3) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM qq_turns t WHERE t.message_id=m.id AND t.status IN ('queued','processing'))
